# Miguel Vázquez-Carrero

> PhD candidate in Economics at Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
> Academic job market: 2027–2028
> Website: https://mvazcar.com/

## Overview

Miguel Vázquez-Carrero is a macroeconomist interested in how firms grow and
compete, and how this shapes productivity and employment. His main work
combines structural models with microdata. He also works on policy evaluation
using experimental and quasi-experimental methods.

## Research Interests

- Firm dynamics
- Competition
- Productivity growth
- Employment and labor-market outcomes
- Quantitative macroeconomics

## Current Research

### From firm demographics to measured TFP

With Andrés Erosa and Sevi Mora. Work in progress.

## Research Methods

- Empirical analysis of microdata
- Structural macroeconomic modeling
- Computational methods

## Open-Source Code

### Modern Pipelines for Spanish Microdata

Python and Polars pipelines for reproducible, large-scale data processing:

- Muestra Continua de Vidas Laborales: https://github.com/mvazcar/MCVL
- Panel de Hogares: https://github.com/mvazcar/panel-de-hogares
- Encuesta Financiera de las Familias: https://github.com/mvazcar/EFF
- Encuesta de Condiciones de Vida: https://github.com/mvazcar/ECV

### Firm Dynamics

- deepHopenhayn: https://github.com/mvazcar/deepHopenhayn
  A Hopenhayn model solved with neural networks.
- firm-dynamics: https://github.com/mvazcar/firm-dynamics
  Code for classic firm-dynamics models.

### Visualizations

- Labor underutilization in Spain:
  https://mvazcar.com/visual/spain-labor-underutilization/
  Interactive quarterly and annual measures constructed from EPA public
  microdata.
